question: Which two organizations signed an MoU to enhance cooperation in narcotics control and cyber-enabled drug crimes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NCB and RRU.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) and Rashtriya Raksha University (RRU) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to enhance cooperation in narcotics control and cyber-enabled drug crimes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The MoU aims to collaborate on research, technology development, and training in areas like darknet narcotics markets, cryptocurrency tracing, and cyber-threat intelligence.**
 
• **Both organizations will develop and deliver specialized training programs on cyber forensics, blockchain forensics, OSINT, and behavioral profiling for NCB officers.**
 
• **A Centre of Excellence in Cybercrime Investigation and Drug Intelligence will be established to foster research and innovation in these fields.**
 
• **The collaboration seeks to enhance capacity building and innovation in combating cyber-enabled drug crimes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB)__

 __
 
• The central agency responsible for enforcing the laws related to narcotics and combating drug trafficking in India.
 
 
 
• Rashtriya Raksha University (RRU)__
 __
 
• An academic institution focused on defense, security, and law enforcement, offering training and research in emerging security threats.
 
 
 
• Cyber-enabled Drug Crimes__
 
 
• Drug-related crimes that leverage cyber technologies, such as darknet markets, cryptocurrency, and digital forensics.
